title: Sebastian Stan Doesn’t Know How ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Turned Out, But Says It’s ‘Probably Heartbreaking’: ‘We’ll See Who Makes It’
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Sebastian Stan, who suited back up as the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes, for the forthcoming “Avengers: Doomsday,” recently revealed he hasn’t actually seen the movie yet — but expects it to be “heartbreaking.”

“I haven’t seen the movie, and I don’t know how it turned out,” the actor admitted while speaking withDecider. “I’m sure it’s going to be probably heartbreaking, in a lot of ways. We’ll see who makes it to the next level.”

Stan did say he got to “reunite with everyone” on set, adding, “It was very nostalgic to look back and think about all of these years that we’ve known each other and grew up together. It’s incredible in that way,” he said. “It’s been a family, and it never stops being that way.”

While fans have interpreted Stan’s comments as a tip that more than a few of the beloved characters will be killed off in the “Avengers: Endgame” follow-up, the actor is the latest “Doomsday” cast member to confess that they don’t really know what to expect when it comes to the film’s narrative. Recently,Alan Cumming, who will reprise his role as the mutant superhero Nightcrawler, toldSiriusXM: “To be honest, I don’t fully understand the plot.” (He first appeared as the character in 2003’s “X2: X-Men United.”) Cumming also noted that most of his scenes were shot “in front of a blue screen.”

Perhaps the confusion stems from theunfinished scriptthe co-directors, Joe and Anthony Russo, shot the film with. “We always view the script as a living organism,” Joe toldthe Associated Presslast month. “We’re improvisation-based, rehearsal-based directors. We like to see what the actors bring to the characters, and sometimes you don’t get the actors until a few days or few weeks before you shoot them. And a lot of the time, that’s when the magic happens.”

Stan first appeared in “Captain America: The First Avenger” in 2011, going on to appear in “Captain America: The Winter Soldier,” “Captain America: Civil War,” “Avengers: Infinity War,” and more Marvel films.

“Fjord,” the actor’s latest film, hits theaters Friday. “Avengers: Doomsday” will premiere theatrically on Dec. 18.
title_zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·史丹(Sebastian Stan)不知道《復仇者聯盟：末日(Avengers: Doomsday)》的最終結果，但表示這部電影「可能會令人心碎」： 「我們會看看誰能活下來。」
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克爾塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

塞巴斯蒂安·史坦(Sebastian Stan)最近重返冬兵角色巴基·巴恩斯(Bucky Barnes)，參與即將上映的《復仇者聯盟：末日(Avengers: Doomsday)》，他透露自己其實還沒有看過這部電影，但預期會是“令人心碎”的。

“我還沒有看過這部電影，也不知道它的結果如何，”這位演員在接受《Decider》訪問時承認。“我相信在很多方面，它可能會是令人心碎的。我們將看看誰能進入下一個階段。”

史坦表示他在片場“與大家重聚”，並補充道：“回想這些年來我們彼此相識並一起成長，真是非常懷舊。從這個角度來看，這是不可思議的。”他說：“這一直是一個家庭，並且永遠不會改變。”

雖然粉絲們將史坦的評論解讀為暗示在《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰(Avengers: Endgame)》的續集裡會有不少受人喜愛的角色被殺掉，但這位演員是最新一位坦承對於電影劇情並不太了解的《末日》的演員。最近，艾倫·卡明(Alan Cumming)重返他在電影中飾演的變種超級英雄夜行者(Nightcrawler)角色，告訴SiriusXM：“老實說，我不完全理解劇情。”（他首次在2003年的《X2：X戰警聯盟(X2: X-Men United)》中出現。）卡明還提到，他的大部分場景都是在“藍幕前”拍攝的。

或許這種困惑源於共同導演喬·羅素(Joe Russo)和安東尼·羅素(Anthony Russo)拍攝電影時所使用的未完成劇本。“我們總是將劇本視為一個活的有機體，”喬上個月告訴《美聯社》。 “我們是基於即興和排練的導演。我們喜歡看看演員為角色帶來什麼，有時候你在拍攝前幾天或幾週才會見到演員。很多時候，那就是魔法發生的時刻。”

史坦首次出現在2011年的《美國隊長：復仇者先鋒(Captain America: The First Avenger)》，隨後又出現在《美國隊長：冬日戰士(Captain America: The Winter Soldier)》、《美國隊長：內戰(Captain America: Civil War)》、《復仇者聯盟：無限之戰(Avengers: Infinity War)》及更多漫威電影中。

史坦最新的電影《峽灣(Fjord)》將於週五上映。《復仇者聯盟：末日(Avengers: Doomsday)》將於12月18日正式上映。
